title: Tarik Tali Tin
subject: a Kelantan paddy farmer and his wife at harvest, taking turns all day in the bamboo hut at the edge of their plot pulling the long string of rattling tin cans to scare the burung pipit off the ripening grain, him pretending he is not tired while she brings the kopi in a tin can
caption: Kelantan-dialect Malay pop ballad in the East Coast regional-song tradition. A bowed rebab carrying the lead melody with slides and ornaments; a gedombak hand drum keeping a slow lilting pattern; a nylon-string acoustic guitar picking broken chords; a soft string pad under the chorus; a low gong on the downbeat of each phrase. Warm unpolished studio, acoustic instruments close, gentle tape warmth. Male mid-range tenor with a plain, unforced village delivery and light Kelantan vowel colour, a female voice answering in the last chorus. 84 BPM, A minor. Wry, patient and quietly fond. No dikir barat call-and-response clapping, no dangdut drums, no trap, no autotune, no power-ballad drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - rebab alone, gedombak joins, low gong]

[Verse 1]
Padi doh kuning, tunduk sapa ke tanah
Burung pipit mari sekawan, hitam satu bendang
Kawe duduk dalam pondok dari subuh
Tali panjang dalam tange, tin susu sepanjang batas

[Pre-Chorus]
Kawe tarik, dio terbang
Kawe lepas, dio mari balik

[Chorus]
Tarik tali tin, tarik tali tin
Bunyi tin berlaga sampai hujung bendang
Demo bawa kopi dalam tin susu
Kawe kato tok penat, demo tahu kawe tipu

[Verse 2]
Tengah hari demo ambik tali dari kawe
Kawe baring kejap atas lantai buluh
Demo tarik sambil nyanyi lagu lamo
Pipit pun tak tahu nok takut ke nok dengar

[Pre-Chorus]
Tange kawe merah, tange demo pun gitu gak
Sapa petang kito bertukar lagi

[Chorus]
Tarik tali tin, tarik tali tin
Sorang tarik, sorang lelap sekejap
Demo bawa kopi dalam tin susu
Kopi demo manis, sama macam selalu

[Bridge - rebab and guitar, gedombak stops]
Matahari jatuh, pipit balik ke sarang
Tali tergantung, tin diam satu-satu

[Chorus - Duet]
Lepas tali tin, lepas tali tin
Esok subuh kito mari lagi
Kopi dalam tin, tinggal separuh
Kawe minum, demo pun minum

[Outro - rebab alone, last low gong]
